## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Breaking change

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated focused tests.
- [ ] I ran `composer test` and `composer format:check`.
- [ ] I updated documentation for public behavior changes.
- [ ] I described breaking changes and migration steps.
